name: Kaya
description: Kaya is a human planeswalker from Tolvada, a ghost hunter and assassin who can phase through matter, known as a former Orzhov guildmaster and a member of the Gatewatch.

summary.text: Kaya is a human planeswalker from Tolvada, a ghost hunter and assassin who can phase through matter, known as a former Orzhov guildmaster and a member of the Gatewatch.

bio.text: Marchesa hired Kaya to put King Brago's ghost to rest, and she killed him with a rondel dagger.

bio.text: Bolas hired her to kill the Obzedat, and she did so and became Orzhov guildmaster through a loophole, then freed many people from Orzhov debts, which led Teysa to end their partnership.

bio.text: She learned of Bolas's treachery and defected from him, then rallied Ravnica's guilds during the War of the Spark and joined the Gatewatch by swearing its Oath.

citations.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

bio.text: The guilds hired her to assassinate Liliana Vess as penance, and in the end she killed an imposter Liliana out of mercy.

citations.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Kaldheim she worked with Tyvar and took the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, and she killed the demon Varragoth by cutting his throat.

citations.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She later helped Saheeli and Teferi build the Temporal Anchor and put Sharaman's ghost to rest, but the Anchor failed and Teferi was lost in the time stream.

citations.text: "Temporal Anchor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sharaman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Temporal Anchor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She joined the strike team to New Phyrexia, tried to stop Jace from detonating the Sylex, and refused Elesh Norn's invitation to join Phyrexia.

citations.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the invasion she killed the compleated Heliod on Theros, and Teysa usurped her place as Orzhov leader while she was away.

citations.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Back on Ravnica she led the Agency's investigation into the Karlov Manor murders after finding Teysa dead, and with Etrata she trapped Oba, choosing not to kill her.

timeline.summary: Marchesa hires Kaya Cassir to put Brago to rest.
timeline.quote: the noblewoman Marchesa d'Amati hired the ghost assassin Kaya Cassir to finally put Brago to rest

citation.text: "Fiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's plan nears fruition; Kaya and Dovin usurp the Orzhov and Azorius while Vraska, Domri and Ral fall under his sway.
timeline.quote: allowing for non-native planeswalkers Kaya Cassir and Dovin Baan to usurp control

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya waits at the Wasp's Nest and her contact, a soldier in disguise wearing an iris brooch, arrives.
timeline.quote: when her contact walked in

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: The soldier leads Kaya upstairs to meet his grace.
timeline.quote: His grace will see you now,

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Revari tells Kaya his late mother's manor is haunted, the workers refuse to enter, and he wants the ghost gone.
timeline.quote: there is no doubt in my mind: the place is haunted

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya accepts the job despite taking an immediate dislike to Revari.
timeline.quote: I'll take the job.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Revari pays Kaya half down and hands over the building plans.
timeline.quote: Half down, as I said in my letter.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya receives an unmarked envelope bearing only the Black Rose symbol, signalling that her big job has begun.
timeline.quote: just a symbol. The Black Rose.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya enters the manor at night and plugs her ears with wax.
timeline.quote: then withdrew the wax plugs from her pockets and worked them into her ears.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya taunts the spirit and the ghost appears in the east wing hallway, a clawed old woman, and shrieks at her.
timeline.quote: A spectral form appeared most of the way down the hallway

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through the wall to dodge the ghost and pins its shawl to the wall with a dagger.
timeline.quote: She lit up one of her daggers and pinned the shawl to the wall.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs the ghost through the palm and wounds it, and it flees through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya runs into a bedroom with no floor, a secret not on the plans, and falls over the edge.
timeline.quote: The bedroom had no floor.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs the ghost's spectral shawl to catch a ride out of the pit.
timeline.quote: closed spectral hands around the spectral shawl

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya pries up floorboards in the wrecked tea room and finds the withered corpse of an old woman resembling the ghost.
timeline.quote: There, in the crawlspace, was the withered corpse of an old woman.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Among the debris Kaya finds Revari's signet ring and realizes the truth about his mother.
timeline.quote: A signet ring. A familiar signet ring.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Revari the ghost is dealt with, and he insists on inspecting the manor before paying.
timeline.quote: I can't be faulted for wishing to inspect your work before remitting payment.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Revari into the east wing room and quietly closes the door behind him.
timeline.quote: Very quietly, Kaya closed the door behind him.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya confronts Revari, calling him kinslayer, as his mother's ghost appears behind him.
timeline.quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya refuses Revari's plea for help and says she is defaulting on the job with cause.
timeline.quote: I'm defaulting, with cause,

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: The ghost falls on Revari with teeth and claws as Kaya walks through the door and leaves him screaming.
timeline.quote: Then his mother's wailing ghost was upon him with those needle teeth and those dagger claws.

citation.text: "Laid to Rest" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana bursts into the dining hall to find Kaya driving a rondel dagger into King Brago's neck.
timeline.quote: a rondel dagger buried deep in the neck of her king

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana swings her sword through Brago's face at the assassin, but Kaya turns translucent and it passes harmlessly.
timeline.quote: She drew her sword and swung it directly through the face of King Brago

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: King Brago dies a second death as a violet necrosis dissolves his ghostly form, leaving his armor and crown.
timeline.quote: in a matter of seconds the king's form had vanished.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
timeline.quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya says she was paid to hit only one mark and will not kill Adriana.
timeline.quote: I was paid to hit only one mark. I'm not going to kill you,

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Adriana that as long as tyrants die, freedom lives, and Adriana is struck by guilt.
timeline.quote: As long as tyrants die, the chance for freedom lives.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya sinks through the floor and escapes.
timeline.quote: The stranger straightened her jacket smartly and dropped into the floor.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Marchesa admits she paid Kaya to kill Brago.
timeline.quote: Well, Kaya killed Brago. Paid her good money for it, too.

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Kaya eliminates Brago's spirit and the Black Rose confiscates the throne.
timeline.quote: The Black Rose confiscated the throne after Brago's spirit was eliminated by the planeswalker Kaya

citation.text: "Conspiracy: Take the Crown", section "Flavor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya lets Jace telepathically extract the activation method and travels with other planeswalkers to New Phyrexia with the duplicate Sylex.
timeline.quote: she allowed Jace Beleren to telepathically extract this information from her.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "A perfect replica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the War of the Spark, Rakdos refuses to cooperate because Hekara was killed.
timeline.quote: Rakdos initially was not cooperating at all with the anti-Bolas efforts because Hekara , his emissary, was killed.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tomik brings back Hekara's corpse and she is revived as a bloodwitch; she beats Exava in a fight and agrees to help Kaya's group.
timeline.quote: Exava tried to object but lost to Hekara in a fight.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns to Ravnica, unites the Golgari and pledges the guild against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska united the Golgari once again and pledged the guild to the fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Possessed Lavinia kills Hekara before Ral Zarek frees her.
timeline.quote: This led to Hekara being killed by Lavinia

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, sent by Bolas, infiltrates the catacombs and kills Grandfather Karlov and the Obzedat, becoming the new Orzhov leader; Teysa is reinstated as leading oligarch.
timeline.quote: Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Awaiting her time". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska leads Golgari forces into Orzhova as a distraction so Kaya can kill the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: she led an army of rot zombies, trolls, and giant insects into Orzhova as a distraction

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas forces Vraska to choose and she betrays Ral Zarek and Kaya.
timeline.quote: she ultimately betrayed them

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Teysa it is time to let the dead be dead.
timeline.quote: Time to let the dead be dead.

citation.text: Ethereal Absolution (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teysa convenes a meeting of the Obzedat and Kaya ends it.
timeline.quote: Kaya ended it.

citation.text: Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dovin ticks off the planeswalkers on Ravnica: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska and Bolas.
timeline.quote: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers

citation.text: Dovin's Acuity (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaya ends a meeting of the Obzedat convened by Teysa.
timeline.quote: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

citation.text: Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orzhov vampires look for allies in case their new guildmaster turns on them after the fate of the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

citation.text: Vizkopa Vampire (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas promises to heal Tolvada's sky in return for Kaya's help killing the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: he had promised her he would heal the sky in return for her assistance in killing the Obzedat on Ravnica

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Tolvada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya discovers Emilio Revari murdered his mother and leaves him to her ghost.
timeline.quote: she uncovered the reality that Emilio was directly responsible for his mother's death

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Fiora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya assassinates the ghostly King Brago.
timeline.quote: she successfully infiltrated Brago's dining room and plunged her rondel dagger into his spectral neck

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Fiora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas hires Kaya to kill the Obzedat and become Orzhov guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Bolas hired her to kill the Obzedat and become guildmaster of Orzhov

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the Ghost Council and becomes guildmaster through a loophole.
timeline.quote: she had become the new guildmaster of the Syndicate

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees many people from Orzhov debts, causing Teysa to end their partnership.
timeline.quote: caused Teysa to end their partnership

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya attends the guild summit and witnesses its dissolution after the murder of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov, and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns the tables, has Teysa arrested and offers the hierarchs a deal.
timeline.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya takes control as Orzhov guildmaster after taking down the Obzedat, at Bolas's behest.
timeline.quote: Lately, the planeswalker Kaya has taken control as guildmaster of Orzhov after taking down the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Under the influence of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya raises tithes from 10% to 40% after forgiving debts, causing riots, then lowers them to 18%.
timeline.quote: Kaya raised Orzhov's existing tithes from 10% to 40% to compensate for the losses caused by forgiving those debts, which quickly led to riots.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Under the influence of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Teysa witness the guild summit's dissolution after Isperia's murder.
timeline.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia .

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Internal struggle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns the tables on the hierarchs, has Teysa arrested and offers them a deal.
timeline.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Internal struggle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees bound ghosts from debt against Teysa's warning; the hierarchs pressure Teysa to arrest her but Tomik helps Kaya, and Teysa is arrested.
timeline.quote: Teysa was then arrested.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Staging another coup". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war Teyo finds Rat again at the Promenade and they walk off together.
timeline.quote: Teyo and Rat walked off together, arm in arm.

citation.text: "Transguild Promenade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat guides Teyo, newly arrived on Ravnica, sharing what she overheard about planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Rat acted as Teyo Verada 's guide to the city plane when the young planeswalker first arrived.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
timeline.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns and unites the Golgari, pledging them to the fight, and civilians are evacuated to the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken that Teyo and Kaya will leave, Rat departs without goodbye, but Teyo finds her and she joins them.
timeline.quote: Rat was heart-broken and left their company before saying goodbye

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria, Rat helps find Liliana, defeat an imposter, and persuade Kaya to let Liliana live.
timeline.quote: Rat helped convince Kaya to let Liliana live

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri first fights the Eternals and helps save Kaya, then sides with Bolas after seeing him topple the Vitu-Ghazi elemental.
timeline.quote: even helped save Kaya in a tight spot

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara first declines Kaya's plan to revive Niv-Mizzet, but Harmony wakes and the Selesnya join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins and Nissa rejoins the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Kaya joined and Nissa rejoined the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas brings the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping planeswalkers, and Kaya defects from him for good.
timeline.quote: Once the Beacon was active, Bolas brought the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping the planeswalkers there

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya befriends Teyo and fights Bolas's forces with Araithia and Ral.
timeline.quote: Alongside many other planeswalkers and Ravnicans, Kaya fought against Bolas' forces

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov triumvirate agrees to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Swayed by Bilagru's arguments, the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani awakens and the Selesnya agree to help the Gatewatch; Araithia wins over the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska pledges the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos resurrect Hekara as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya represents the Orzhov in a ritual to restore the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Kaya served as the representative for the Orzhov Syndicate

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya joins the Gatewatch to atone and is assigned to assassinate Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: Seeking to atone for her past mistakes, she joined the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As his first act, Niv-Mizzet sends Ral, Vraska and Kaya to hunt down Tezzeret, Dovin and Liliana as penance.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet's first act as Living Guildpact was to have Ral, Vraska , and Kaya undergo penance for allying with Bolas but defecting before the War

timeline.summary: Jaya secretly tracks Liliana to Dominaria and escorts Kaya, Teyo and Rat to her.
timeline.quote: Jaya secretly tracked Liliana to Dominaria

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tomik finds a loophole letting Kaya transfer her Orzhov contracts to him so she can planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Tomik Vrona discovered a legal loophole that allowed Kaya to temporarily transfer her Orzhov contracts and guild responsibilities to him

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana agrees to let Kaya kill her in exchange for defeating her imposter.
timeline.quote: Liliana regained consciousness and agreed to let Kaya kill her in exchange for defeating her imposter and freeing her people

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the imposter Liliana out of mercy.
timeline.quote: Kaya killed the mistress out of mercy

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana gives up the Chain Veil, which is delivered as proof of her death.
timeline.quote: Teyo suggested that Liliana give up the Veil, which she reluctantly did

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya's group meets Liliana, now called Ana Iora, on Fiora.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who had changed her name to Ana Iora

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya is hired to hunt Liliana down.
timeline.quote: Kaya was hired to hunt Liliana down.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the imposter Liliana out of mercy.
timeline.quote: but the mistress was killed by Kaya out of mercy

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Inga orders a war party into the Aldergard forest, noting Kaya came up with the idea.
timeline.quote: I want a war party ready to set off within the hour.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: In the Aldergard, Asi and an Omenseeker discuss whether the culprit is the Cosmos Monster Sarulf.
timeline.quote: He is one of the Cosmos Monsters.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Asi's raven Hakka returns and leads the party to a cave.
timeline.quote: my friend may have found us a lead

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: In the cave Kaya spots strange metallic veins and warns an Omenseeker not to touch them.
timeline.quote: veins of some kind of metal ran along the wall and ceiling of the cave

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The party finds a monster feeding on a dire bear; it kills Omenseekers by fusing with and absorbing them.
timeline.quote: one was pinned beneath the creature, screaming as the spindly arms sank into his face

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Inga freezes the monster's arm with a lantern spell and Kaya severs it with her dagger.
timeline.quote: lopping it off at the shoulder

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through the cave wall to escape being cornered and then cuts through one of the monster's legs.
timeline.quote: she jammed all the arcane power she could muster into her blade and lunged

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Asi glows with divine light, revealed as Alrund, and shields the party with a barrier; the monster flees into the metal vein.
timeline.quote: it seemed to sink into the metal, as it if were a thick and viscous liquid

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund explains gods travel in mortal guise and Kaya berates him for letting the monster escape.
timeline.quote: It suits the gods, from time to time, to travel in mortal guise

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund promises Kaya the longship of Cosima to pursue the creature across realms.
timeline.quote: the longship of Cosima will aid you in this quest

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Alrund opens a doorway into the void and warns of a coming Doomskar.
timeline.quote: I fear a Doomskar approaches—one unlike any in living memory.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Travelers" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya rides Cosima's longship through the Cosmos and learns from Inga about Omenpaths and Doomskars.
timeline.quote: It was the Doomskars people feared, though—celestial collisions that seemed invariably to lead to calamity.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The longship lands Kaya on a muddy bank in an ancient forest in the Gnottvold, then departs.
timeline.quote: the boat lurched back into the waves as if it had been pushed

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds a crowd of trolls and a hooded man on a stone block calling himself Valki, the God of Lies.
timeline.quote: All know me as Valki, and my first gift to you, the gift of languages, is free.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya blows away Valki's illusion, revealing the devil planeswalker Tibalt.
timeline.quote: in place of the God of Lies stood a red-skinned man with two prominent horns

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt orders his trolls to kill Kaya; she incapacitates two with phasing, and the others flee.
timeline.quote: The second jabbed at her with a rusty, ancient-looking sword.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya chases Tibalt and corners him; he says chaos is its own reward and denies knowledge of the monster.
timeline.quote: Chaos is its own reward, and nothing puts a smile on my face like a bit of mayhem.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt whistles and wakes six Torga trolls from beneath the hills.
timeline.quote: One after another, they pulled free of the earth, showering the clearing with clumps of black dirt.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt opens a portal to a fiery realm with a glass sword and leaves Kaya with the trolls.
timeline.quote: With that, he stepped through the portal.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya fights the Torga trolls, her dagger breaking and another lodging in a troll's spine.
timeline.quote: she watched the dagger she'd had since Tolvada break in two

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar Kell arrives and turns all six Torga trolls to stone with a touch.
timeline.quote: He dodged another blow, turned another troll to stone, and another.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
timeline.quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies the portal's destination as Immersturm, realm of demons, and links the plan to the Doomskar.
timeline.quote: Immersturm," said Tyvar.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar opens a doorway into the Cosmos, and Kaya spots his Zendikari charm and realizes he is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Holy ancients. You're a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt leaves a trail with the sword through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
timeline.quote: he was leaving a trail, dragging the tip through the black basalt surface of Immersturm

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt foretells that he will kill the planeswalker and Kaldheim will burn.
timeline.quote: Tibalt kills the planeswalker.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Tyvar step out of Tyvar's Omenpath into the hot, lava-filled demons' realm.
timeline.quote: On the other side of Tyvar's Omenpath, a blast of hot, noxious air had greeted her.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar explains the gods sealed the realm long ago and that Tibalt must have damaged the wards.
timeline.quote: But Tibalt must have somehow damaged the wards.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: They find an orange molten arrow carved into the basalt, left for them by Tibalt.
timeline.quote: an orange molten arrow

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar unexpectedly grows a bridge of stone across the magma.
timeline.quote: tendrils of rock twining together, knitting themselves into a bridge

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Tyvar about the planes and planeswalkers; he declines to become one.
timeline.quote: But I think I'll pass.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Tyvar needs a code; he refuses her schooling and stalks off down the path.
timeline.quote: With that, he stormed off, down the path of black rock.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Demons on a ship hurl harpoons at Tyvar, and Kaya phases him to save him.
timeline.quote: Kaya reached him just in time, turning his torso to ghostly light

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: A spiked demon longship drives toward them across the magma lake.
timeline.quote: Spikes ringed the outer edge, cruel and narrow

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns a harpoon immaterial and throws it through the mace-armed demon's breastplate.
timeline.quote: It punched clean through the demon's hammered breastplate and out the other side.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya's hand-spear strike fails to kill the big demon jarl, but she phases the path from under him and drops him into the lava.
timeline.quote: she sent him flailing backwards into the molten rock and allowed the path to rematerialize over him

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar grows two iron hand-axes from the demon jarl's hammer metal and gives them to the unarmed Kaya.
timeline.quote: Two, actually. Grown from the ground, like stalks of wheat.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: They take the demon longship across the lava toward the Bloodcrag.
timeline.quote: once the demon ship built up speed, it smashed through the plates of cooled magma

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: They see the Bloodcrag, where the light of the gods mirrors the light from Tibalt's portal.
timeline.quote: That's the Bloodcrag!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Partway up the Bloodcrag, they see hundreds of demon ships on the lava lake, an army.
timeline.quote: The ship we ran across must have been part of their vanguard.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Tibalt's sword opens portals and means to start a Doomskar; Tibalt answers that he already has.
timeline.quote: Kid, he's going to start a Doomskar!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt attacks from above with flame, and Kaya charges at him and hurls an axe.
timeline.quote: It clipped his shoulder, sent him sprawling

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt breathes out a torrent of burning smoke that fills Kaya's mind with despair and doubt.
timeline.quote: The smoke poured from his mouth in a great and sudden torrent

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar, immune to the doubt magic, blocks Tibalt's killing blow and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: He'd caught that shimmering god-light sword on the dagger fixed to his bracer.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tells them to go see for himself, then dissolves into cinders and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Like burning paper, his body dissolved into a mass of orange cinders

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: From the peak they see a vast tear in the sky showing a kaleidoscope of other planes.
timeline.quote: they had a clear view of the tear in the sky

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth and thousands of demons rise from the lava lake and head for the hole in the sky.
timeline.quote: There must have been thousands of them, all headed for that hole in the sky.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar accuses planeswalkers of fleeing when things get hard, and opens an Omenpath to leave.
timeline.quote: You and that Tibalt aren't so different in the end.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya, despite her code, follows Tyvar through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Kaya swore, took a deep breath, and stepped in after him.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni and Fynn arrive at the Beskir Stronghold, where Inga Rune-Eyes and Sigrid await with strangers Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers, had already arrived, and this fortress belonged to Sigrid, God-Favored.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya lays the Sword of the Realms on the table, and they learn Koll finished it but died with the secret of wielding it.
timeline.quote: But he took the secrets of how to wield it to the grave.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
timeline.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: From the air they see a rift to Karfell spilling draugr and undead trolls toward a bridge.
timeline.quote: from the edge of the opening thin, rotting figures dragged themselves hand over hand into the human realm

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: They see Halvar alone on the bridge before a heap of destroyed draugr.
timeline.quote: Before him, on the near side of the bridge, was a mound of destroyed draugr nearly waist-high.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
timeline.quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
timeline.quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
timeline.quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Cosima leaps from the river as a dolphin and sweeps a wall of water over an undead troll and draugr.
timeline.quote: It swept over the undead Torga and a handful of draugr.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Cosima joins Kaya to reach Halvar, sent by Alrund.
timeline.quote: Alrund did not send me to visit.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth lands on the ground between them and the bridge.
timeline.quote: He beat his wings once, then settled on the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Cosima fight Varragoth; Kaya's axes wound him but he is barely slowed.
timeline.quote: The second axe, this one in Kaya's hand, drove into his knee.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald's elves arrive and form a pike wall against the demons.
timeline.quote: A line of pike-bearers set their hafts against the ground, forming a wall between Kaya and the demons.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
timeline.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
timeline.quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald carries Kaya on his reindeer through the battle to the bridge.
timeline.quote: He pulled her onto the reindeer.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
timeline.quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Halvar asks them to hold the bridge while he sits and channels the sword.
timeline.quote: Hold the bridge until I can separate the realms once more.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
timeline.quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Valkyries' companion Niko Aris after saving them from a draugr.
timeline.quote: Niko. Niko Aris.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe while he is distracted by Tyvar.
timeline.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells Kaya he wants to see the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: I'd like to see what there is to see, out in your Multiverse.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko asks Kaya whether a plane called Theros exists.
timeline.quote: These planes. Is there one called Theros?

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Representatives of Bretagard's clans gather at Beskir Stronghold with Tyvar and Kaya; Sigrid urges unity against the invaders.
timeline.quote: Sigrid urged unity, revealing that the realms faced a shared threat

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya presents the Sword of the Realms; Alrund reveals it was made for Halvar, and the group sets out to find him.
timeline.quote: it had been made for Halvar , God of Battle, who alone could master it.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Varragoth attacks the heroes on giant ravens; Kaya phases them into incorporeal form to survive the fall.
timeline.quote: Kaya managed to phase them into incorporeal form just before they hit the river below

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar goes to intercept his brother Harald; Cosima washes away an undead troll threatening Kaya.
timeline.quote: until Cosima , God of the Voyage, arrived and washed away the undead with a summoned wave.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Varragoth intercepts Kaya and Cosima; Tyvar and the elven army united under Harald rescue them and let Kaya and Harald reach Halvar.
timeline.quote: the timely arrival of Tyvar and the elven army, now united under Harald

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya gives Halvar the Sword; as he begins the ritual, Koma emerges through a tear in the sky and glides into Karfell's rift, disrupting the undead flow.
timeline.quote: Kaya gave Halvar the Sword of the Realms, which he accepted solemnly.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valkyries and Niko Aris pour out of the rift; Kaya phases through Varragoth's arm and cuts his throat with an axe, killing him.
timeline.quote: She phased through the demon's arm and swung an axe clean through his throat.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halvar completes the ritual and the Doomskar is sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts; the gods vanish; Tyvar accepts Kaya's invitation; Niko learns she cannot return to Theros.
timeline.quote: the Doomskar was sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts between realms.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Tyvar fail to stop Tibalt from creating a Doomskar, and thousands of demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
timeline.quote: thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm

citation.text: "Immersturm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
